mainEntity.name: What is the closest open-source alternative to n8n?

acceptedAnswer.text: Activepieces is a close visual option with an open-source core and an on-prem hosting path. Node-RED is a lightweight open-source flow tool, while Windmill and Kestra suit more technical teams. Check each project's licence and hosted-product terms.

mainEntity.name: Which n8n alternative is easiest for beginners?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zapier is usually the simplest starting point for common SaaS connections. Make is also visual, but its scenarios and credit model can take more time to understand.

mainEntity.name: Which n8n alternatives can be self-hosted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Activepieces lists on-prem hosting, Node-RED is self-hosted, Windmill supports self-hosting, and Kestra can run on your infrastructure. Zapier, Make and Power Automate are managed cloud products.
n8n publishes source under the Sustainable Use License, which permits certain personal and internal business uses but is not an OSI-approved open-source licence.

mainEntity.name: Is Pipedream still a good n8n alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not choose Pipedream Workflows for a new migration without a transition plan. Pipedream has announced that Workflows and String will shut down on March 31, 2027. Its Connect product is not affected.
